ruleset.name: Calculator correctness and maintainability
ruleset.description: Project-specific guard checks plus standard Java rules. Guard checks are syntactic heuristics, not a proof of correctness.

rule.name: MissingZeroDivisorGuard
rule.message: Division in eval has no explicit zero-divisor guard
rule.description: Require an explicit y == 0.0 check in this calculator method before division.

rule.name: MissingOperatorGuard
rule.message: Operator reaches switch without an explicit input guard
rule.description: Require an op check in an if condition before the string switch.
